author: benhur
text:
Hi Gian

To understand how to define a SD zone, we must understand what is behind the zone in terms of Order Flow. We expect that the inner boundary of the zone to be the price where remaining stacks of orders are waiting for execution. Since all we have is the chart, we can spot it by a closer look at the candles. There we look where was the last trade before one side overcome the other. Thinking in Order flow terminology, we may suspect that if one side overcome the other, there might be more orders of the winner side which couldent be filled due to less orders of the loosing side.
